reference.source: INPE PRODES, Legal Amazon, yearly deforestation

caveats: PRODES maps only the first clearing of primary forest, so alerts on land cleared before 2019 can be neither confirmed nor rejected by it.
Precision on the whole AOI understates agreement; precision on forest only compares the two sources over the same ground.
The comparison uses two dry-season snapshots, 2018 and 2023, so clearings that regrew in between can be missed.
